meaning.en: To emit a strong foul odor.
meaning.vi: Phát ra mùi hôi nồng nặc.

meaning.en: Stink is defined as to give off a bad smell, or is slang meaning to be low quality.
meaning.vi: Stink được định nghĩa là tạo ra mùi hôi, hoặc theo tiếng lóng có nghĩa là chất lượng thấp.

meaning.en: (slang) To have much or an excess.

meaning.en: To be very offensive; be hateful or abhorrent.

meaning.en: To be in extremely bad repute.
meaning.vi: Có danh tiếng cực kỳ tồi tệ.

meaning.en: To be morally offensive or have the appearance of dishonesty or corruption.

meaning.en: To have something to an extreme or offensive degree.

meaning.en: To give off a strong, unpleasant smell.

meaning.en: (informal) To be of low standard or quality; be no good.

meaning.en: (intransitive) To have a strong bad smell.

meaning.en: (intransitive) To give an impression of dishonesty or untruth.

meaning.en: The definition of a stink is a nasty smell, or is slang for a public outrage.
meaning.vi: Định nghĩa về mùi hôi là một mùi khó chịu, hoặc là một từ lóng để chỉ sự phẫn nộ của công chúng.

meaning.en: A strong offensive odor; a stench.

meaning.en: A strong, unpleasant smell; stench.
meaning.vi: Một mùi khó chịu, nồng nặc; bốc mùi hôi thối.

meaning.en: (informal) A strong public reaction, as one of outrage, censure, protest, etc.
